ten.tiebreak_base_rate_by_event.reviewed_by: Agent certification review (Claude), Phase 10, 2026-11-10; not human verified.

catalog_clauses.clause: share of matches with at least one tiebreak, per tournament
share of matches won without dropping a set, per tournament
over the last three editions (1095-day window), weighted with half-life 18 months (548 days)
shrunk to the tour-level rate with n/(n+60) (n = effective weighted count)
provide split by round and best_of (event x round x best_of cell, shrunk n/(n+60) to the tour rate for that round and best_of)

ten.tiebreak_base_rate_by_event.timing_rule: features use only matches with a tournament start date strictly before the match's tournament start date; replay truncation, future-perturbation and own-game gates pass
